sentences.text: I hate deep cleaning the house.
I swear no matter how much I declutter, there's always more junk.
sentences.text_ko: 아무리 정리해도 계속 뭐가 나오는 것 같아.

sentences.text: Where does all this stuff even come from?
sentences.text_ko: 이 물건들은 도대체 어디서 다 나오는 걸까?

sentences.text: But if I don't use it, it's gotta go.
Can you take out the trash while I mop?
sentences.text_ko: 내가 물걸레질하는 동안 쓰레기 좀 버려줄래?

sentences.text: But only if I get to skip cleaning the bathroom.
Lucky for you, I already did it.
sentences.text_ko: 운 좋네, 이미 내가 다 해놨어.

sentences.text: Want me to throw in a load of laundry?
Oh, and don't forget to fold them after they dry.
sentences.text_ko: 마르면 빨래 개는 것도 잊지 말고.

sentences.text: That's the best part, because I can watch our show while I do it.
sentences.text_ko: 그게 제일 좋은 점이야. 빨래 개면서 우리 드라마 볼 수 있거든.

sentences.text: You better not watch without me.
sentences.text_ko: 나 빼고 먼저 보면 안 된다?

full_transcript: Day 10. Deep cleaning. I hate deep cleaning the house. I swear no matter how much I declutter, there's always more junk. Tell me about it. Where does all this stuff even come from? No clue. But if I don't use it, it's gotta go. Can you take out the trash while I mop? Sure. But only if I get to skip cleaning the bathroom. Lucky for you, I already did it. Thanks. Want me to throw in a load of laundry? Yes, please. Oh, and don't forget to fold them after they dry. Of course. That's the best part, because I can watch our show while I do it.
